__inputs.name: DS_PROMETHEUS
__inputs.label: Prometheus
__inputs.description: Prometheus datasource that scrapes the Fred backends.

title: Fred / Chat failure investigation
description: Terminal chat turn failures and observed ReAct and Deep LLM invocation failures.

list.name: chat_lookback
list.label: Lookback
list.description: Set the rolling window for the chat failure rate, turn volume, and HTTP 5xx rate by service. Auto adapts to the time range and Prometheus scrape interval.

list.name: reason
list.label: Reason
list.query: 5xx : http_5xx, 429 : http_429, 400 : http_400, Other 4xx : http_other_4xx, Stream interrupted : stream_interrupted, Timeout or connection failure : timeout_or_connection, Context limit : context_limit, Tool or capability failure : tool_or_capability, Internal or unknown : internal_or_unknown, Reason unavailable : ^$

panels.title: Failed turns by reason
panels.description: Each reason shows its share of all recorded chat turns in the lookback window. Hover for estimated failed and total turn counts.

panels.title: Failure reason trends
panels.description: Compare each reason's share of all recorded chat turns on the same baseline. The time range and Lookback also apply here.

options.content:
**5xx** Check the gateway or provider. Consider a Fred banner if user impact is sustained.  
**429** Check rate limits and quota.  
**400** Check request shape, model settings and recent Fred changes.  
**Other 4xx** Check credentials, permissions and the endpoint.

panels.title: LLM invocation failures
panels.description: Estimated failed invocations by reason per lookback window. The Model, Route and Reason filters apply here. A successful Fred retry adds a separate successful invocation.

panels.title: Model invocation failure trends
panels.description: Compare estimated failed model invocation counts by reason on the same baseline. Model, Route, and Reason apply here.

panels.title: LLM invocations by model and route
panels.description: Each failure cell shows its rate across all invocations for that model and route, followed by the estimated count in parentheses. Total includes all terminal outcomes, including cancellations. Click a column heading to sort by rate or total. Reason columns appear when that reason occurs in the selected time range.
